name: FE-driven Lambda keep-warm (opal-partners-data cold-start elimination)
description: Andrew GO decision-a 2026-06-03. Eliminate the ~5.4s opal-partners-data cold-start that hits nearly every Advisor-Intelligence page load (196 cold starts/7d), via a CLEVER FE-driven warm-ping tied to active user presence — ~$0.15/mo (follows the user, $0 idle) vs ~$27+/mo provisioned-concurrency. Two-lane: Lane A (0.7.0_AE) no-op ?warm=1 early-return branch in opal-partners-data + opal-portal-data-proxy BEHIND edge auth (Terraform, no anon endpoint); Lane B (0.4.2_RD) useLambdaKeepWarm presence-gated (visibility) + view-targeted (Advisor-Intel + Portfolios only) + debounced/jittered ~4min heartbeat hook on the authed api-client. Design-of-record = AE feasibility brief 91df57398. Cold-start root: `import awswrangler` at module init -> any route warms the container ~5-15min. Workers fast-tracked parallel (settled design); PRD = documentation not gate.
